jobs.prompt: Extreme close-up, static locked camera. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana presses his face between black fence bars, big glossy eyes looking up at the camera. He slowly blinks once and gives a tiny whimper. Cool blue night light in a clean home basement. Quiet room tone.

High wide shot, static locked camera. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana lies alone on the floor beside an empty steel bowl. He stays still; only his eyes move, glancing to the side. Cool blue night light in a clean home basement. A clock ticks softly.

Close-up, static locked camera. A hand in a navy knit sleeve spoons pieces of steaming cooked chicken into a steel dog bowl on a white marble kitchen island, then lifts the spoon away. Steam rises. Warm amber light. Soft clink of spoon on bowl.

Medium shot, static locked camera. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana sitting on the floor suddenly perks his ears straight up and tilts his head to one side, listening. Cool blue night light in a clean home basement. A door opens upstairs, footsteps on stairs.

Static locked camera. Seen from behind, A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana wags his big fluffy curled tail fast with excitement, body wiggling, facing away from the camera. Cool blue night light in a clean home basement. Footsteps coming closer.

Medium shot, static locked camera. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana sitting by an empty steel bowl droops his ears and slowly lies down flat on the floor, chin beside the bowl, sad eyes looking up. Footsteps fade away, a door closes upstairs, he sighs. Cool blue night light in a clean home basement.

Close-up, static locked camera. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana lying on the floor lifts his head and lets out a long dramatic awoo howl, mouth rounded, then lowers his head. Cool blue night light in a clean home basement.

Medium shot, static locked camera. A hand in a navy sleeve lowers a steaming bowl of chicken down onto the floor inside the black fence and pulls back out of frame. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana lifts his head, eyes wide with joy. Warm golden light. Upbeat music starts.

Medium close-up, static locked camera. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana happily eats chicken from the steel bowl on the floor, chewing with his eyes half closed, tail wagging. Warm golden light. Munching sounds.

Close-up, static locked camera. A fluffy Alaskan Malamute puppy with a lime-green bandana licks his lips once, closes his mouth and looks up into the camera with big glossy eyes. Warm golden light. Soft happy music.
